en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Salih Bin Saeed Al Rashidy, from Yunus, 
(It has been narrated) from them<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
The superior act during entering the Masjid is that you begin with your right foot when you enter, and with your left foot when you exit’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Salih ibn Sa‘id al-Rashidiy from Yunus who has said the following: “’A’immah, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, have said, ‘
When entering a Masjid, it is better to step in with the right foot and to step out with left foot when leaving a Masjid.”
